patch_description:
This version precomputes model sizes and KV-cache weights, uses a stronger multi-start construction portfolio, and retains lexicographic local search with moves, swaps, and one-for-two exchanges.

The construction phase now includes the proven size-, weight-, density-, and capacity-risk-oriented orders, plus objective-aware orders that prioritize high KV-pressure models and large memory-risk models. Each candidate placement is evaluated using the full sorted pressure vector rather than only the maximum pressure, which improves balancing among tied bottleneck GPUs. Memory feasibility is checked throughout, and the returned structure remains a dictionary from GPU id to assigned model objects.
